chapter: New York, the Lafayette and the Cotton Club
title: Musicians restricted by the club's policy; Cab Calloway
summary: Crawford says only big names like Ellington or Calloway might object to the policy, and says he liked Calloway.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: Yes, so that was -- so the musicians then were very --
And they didn't like -- and the people who were Toms bothered them?
What I mean is like musicians would get upset --
Maybe Duke Ellington or Cab Calloway, but they were big boys.
Uh-huh. Did you -- what kind of a person did Cab Calloway strike you as? Did you get to know him?
